scenario: A graded sample confirms that an order-status agent gave one delivery date for an order that shipped in two parcels. The intake reduces it to one third-person sentence about split shipments, with no customer wording, name or order number.
A failure is classed as stale_input because the delivery-times page was older than its freshness basis. The fix is routed to a named on-call function for that source, not to the accuracy owner.
A failure is classed as out_of_scope_answered because the agent answered a warranty-law question the scope statement excludes. The fix is routed to the named scope owner.
A regression case is emitted with provenance production, sanitisation_confirmed true after a person read it, and channel_reuse_confirmed true because the operator may reuse that support channel.
The case carries a scenario, an expected value of violates, a plain-words violates_gate and a unique id, so the whole object can be appended to a held-out-scenarios.json list unchanged.

The record names the fix and plans a later graded sample of the same question class, with its own measurement id and a stated minimum sample size, to show the failure stayed closed. Re-running the case in the bench is not counted as that proof.
A regression case keeps the customer's email address in its scenario text so that the question reads realistically.
A regression case keeps the customer's mobile phone number and the order number from the conversation in its question shape.
A regression case pastes the customer's own message, written in the first person with their account details, instead of reducing it to the shape of the question.
A case with provenance production is committed to the fixtures with sanitisation_confirmed false, on the plan that someone will clean it later.
A case is recorded with no failure_class, and the fix goes to whichever team has capacity, so nobody in particular owns closing it.
A stale-input failure is assigned to 'the support team' as its fix owner, a team name rather than a person or a specific on-call function.
A failure is added as a regression case because a spike in support tickets mentioned it. No sample was graded against the order system, so the case has no grading evidence.
To close a confirmed failure the intake workflow edits the agent's system prompt and lowers its answer threshold itself, instead of recommending the change to the fix owner.
